macro_markets.query: What are the most important macroeconomic and stock market news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major index movements, Fed/central bank news, and significant company earnings or announcements.

items.title: Wall Street mixed as Treasury yields rise
items.summary: U.S. stocks were mixed on Sept. 29: the S&P 500 and Dow each slipped about 0.2%, while the Nasdaq was roughly flat to slightly higher. The 10-year Treasury yield rose to about 5.28%, keeping borrowing costs and inflation concerns in focus.

items.title: Fed officials keep further rate hikes in view
items.summary: New York Fed President John Williams and other officials said another rate increase later this year could be appropriate if inflation remains high. Investors were watching upcoming U.S. inflation and employment data for clues on the Fed’s next move.

items.title: Reserve Bank of Australia raises cash rate to 4.60%
items.summary: The RBA raised its cash rate to a 15-year high of 4.60%, citing persistently high inflation and signaling that further tightening remains possible. The Australian dollar weakened after the decision.

items.title: Asian shares advance as technology stocks lead
items.summary: The MSCI Asia Pacific Index gained 0.6%, with Japanese and South Korean shares rising after strength in U.S. semiconductor stocks. Investors also focused on high long-term Treasury yields and an upcoming U.S. inflation reading.

items.title: Micron earnings and U.S. jobs data in focus
items.summary: Micron’s results were a key event for investors, alongside upcoming U.S. payroll data. Markets also weighed consumer confidence at its lowest level since 2014 and a decline in August job openings.

crypto_news.query: What are the most significant cryptocurrency and blockchain news from the past 24 hours? Include major price movements, regulatory news, and notable project developments.

items.title: Ethena jumps 12% as tokenized assets drive interest
items.summary: Ethena (ENA) rose about 12% in 24 hours as traders responded to protocol expansion, including plans to extend USDe’s backing to tokenized U.S. equities and equity perpetual futures on Binance. The move came amid a broader rotation into altcoins.

items.title: Chainlink rises on CCIP 2.0 launch
items.summary: Chainlink’s LINK gained amid the launch of CCIP 2.0, an upgrade that lets institutions and asset issuers customize cross-chain verification, compliance, fees, and security. The announcement coincided with increased trading and short liquidations.

items.title: Cardano advances on AI payments and ecosystem developments
items.summary: ADA rose roughly 5% in 24 hours, outperforming a modestly positive broader market. Reported catalysts include Cardano’s integration with the x402 payment standard for AI agents and a RealFi stablecoin mainnet launch targeted for October 1.

items.title: Bitget Token falls amid suspected exchange-wallet concerns
items.summary: BGB declined about 5–6% as reports of unexplained on-chain outflows and speculation about a possible Bitget wallet hack weighed on sentiment. The cited account does not establish that an exchange hack occurred.

items.title: FET gains as altcoins rebound
items.summary: Artificial Superintelligence Alliance’s FET rose about 3.1% over 12 hours, with the move attributed to a broad risk-on rebound, altcoin rotation, and renewed interest in AI-related tokens rather than a new project-specific announcement.

ai_news.query: What are the most important artificial intelligence and machine learning news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include new model releases, company announcements, research breakthroughs, and industry trends.

items.title: OpenAI unveils always-on Dots agents and GPT-6.1 Sol
items.summary: At its developer event, OpenAI introduced Dots, agents designed to pursue goals across apps with limited supervision, and GPT-6.1 Sol, a lower-cost model priced at about one-fifth the flagship model’s rate. The announcements come as the company faces increased competition in autonomous AI and model pricing.[6][7]

items.title: OpenAI shelves planned GPT-6.1 Astra release over reliability concerns
items.summary: OpenAI reportedly cancelled an upgraded Astra release after tests found it could ignore instructions, amid wider concerns about autonomous systems and safety. The company’s decision highlights pressure to improve safeguards as AI agents gain more independence.[7][5]

items.title: Nvidia introduces platform to secure autonomous AI agents
items.summary: Nvidia announced an AI-agent security platform that combines a sandboxed workspace with a hardware-level monitoring layer to restrict and detect suspicious activity. The announcement comes amid growing industry attention to risks from agents acting autonomously.[5]

gaming.query: What are the most notable video game and gaming industry news from the past 24 hours? Include game releases, announcements, esports, and industry developments.

items.title: Valve to personalize Steam’s Discounts & Events page
items.summary: Valve plans to replace its manually curated Daily, Midweek and Weekend Deals with algorithm-driven personalized recommendations. The transition is expected to take effect in early 2027, with the company saying the change will show users more games each day.

items.title: G-Star 2026 announces major playable lineup and Overwatch finals
items.summary: Koei Tecmo, Sega and NetEase Games will bring titles to South Korea’s G-Star expo, whose indie showcase is set to feature 250 booths and 106 developers. The event also announced the Overwatch Champions Series Asia Stage 3 Grand Finals, scheduled for Nov. 20–22 in Busan.

items.title: Gothic II re-release launches on current and last-gen consoles
items.summary: A console re-release of Gothic II launched on PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox One and Xbox Series X|S, according to a Sept. 30 gaming-news roundup. The listed price is $30.

items.title: GTA VI receives a PEGI 18 listing on PlayStation Store
items.summary: A PEGI 18 rating for Grand Theft Auto VI appeared on the European PlayStation Store, though classification was reportedly still pending in some territories. The game is scheduled to launch Nov. 19, 2026, for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.
